permit.quote: Please note that viewing history, recommendations, “continue watching” and similar information may be made available through various features and user experiences, such as Partner interfaces that are integrated with the Netflix service.

prohibit.quote: We do not share information about title selections of shows or movies you have watched on our service.

conflicts.situation: Netflix suggests content in a Partner's TV or device interface and shows the member's viewing history or continue-watching titles there.
conflicts.reason: The prohibition sits under Netflix Marketing Providers but is worded without limit. The policy does not say whether it also covers Partners, and gives no exception for Partner interfaces.

permit.quote: We may capture up to 10 images of your fingers while you play, which are sent to our servers for the purpose of training our machine learning models.

prohibit.quote: When you use such real time features, note that personal information included in the videos or images is processed on your device and shall not be uploaded to our servers.

conflicts.situation: A Simply Guitar user plays with the camera on and receives on-device guidance while the app captures images of the user's fingers.
conflicts.reason: The on-device statement gives no exception for upload, while the Guitar text sends finger images captured during play to servers. The consent clause covers AI training only. The policy does not say which governs.

permit.quote: we will use Stripe or Paypal as a third party payment processor to process information related to the transaction

prohibit.quote: We do not store nor process any Personal Data when you process the payment.

conflicts.situation: A user buys a subscription on the Simply website, and Stripe or PayPal processes the transaction information.
conflicts.reason: Simply says it uses Stripe or PayPal to process transaction information, yet says it processes no Personal Data at payment. The policy does not say whether the processor acts for Simply.
